decisions.reason: As a newly launched product with its own dedicated webpage, the aloe vera facial care line likely has strategic importance and would usually be given more time by a small established German manufacturer.
The hyaluronic acid serum fits a mainstream skincare segment and, despite lighter website emphasis, is still likely to be retained while the firm builds sales after launch.

The facial cleansing milk appears to be a supporting range product with somewhat less visible commitment, but a small long-standing firm would still often keep it on the market beyond its first year unless results were clearly weak.
